endpoint.selection: Published global endpoint or exact scoped override; no inferred region/pool
endpoint.ref_validation: Caller ResourceRef scope/service/generation/kind/endpointID/URL and root shape checked before credential/resource I/O

request.body: types.ResourceRef, mobilefarm.DeviceSettingsRequest source DTO fields; private wire encoder preserves optional false/empty collections and native timestamp strings, no SDK defaults. Exact caller root device ref checked before I/O where provided.

response.mapping: 204 strictly bodyless returns status acknowledgement;202 response schema absent, bounded protected body plus Incomplete and Accepted receipt.202 may be empty; never assume bodyless or completion. At leastproxy orwifi required, explicitfalse preserved, proxy.enabletrue requires token_fingerprint.

errors.mapping: Shared safe SDK status taxonomy and HTTPStatus, documented400/401/402(payment)/403/404/405/409/429 as applicable; provider raw messages/filter bodies omitted. Confirmed rejections retain Rejected receipt; unknown one attempt without replay; decode failures preserve accepted receipt and trustworthy refs.

retry: No replay; one resource attempt on unknown outcome. Documented 4xx rejection statuses retain rejected receipt;500/transport/decode failures preserve uncertainty/acceptance as applicable.

recovery.reason: No causal mutation observation/replay proof; explicit exact-ref Get may observe device but does not prove task completion or retry safety.
